2608.24419.title: A Judge Should Know What Changed:Construct Validity for LLM-as-a-Judge Evaluation
2608.24419.paper_summary: LLM-as-a-judge evaluation is usually assessed by agreement and robustness to surface perturbations, but reliability does not establish construct validity. We formalize construct validity for an evaluator as a two-dimensional profile: invariance S, the probability that a verdict is unchanged under construct-preserving edits, and construct sensitivity R, the probability that it changes under minimal construct-changing edits. We show that S and R are independent and that no scalar summary preserves all relevant comparisons. We measure the profile across 7 judges and 4 domains using 7 construct-changing intervention types and 5 register-only controls, with intervention direction determined by human annotators and generation, verification, and judging assigned to disjoint model families. At matched invariance S >= 0.90, judges average S = 0.945 but R = 0.319. Sensitivity also differs between scope and strength edits: R_scope = 0.383 versus R_strength = 0.262, a +0.121 gap with the same sign for all 7 judges. We further audit five public label sets and find that surface-only predictors reproduce 55%-67% of labels in paired mode, including 67.4% of MT-Bench human votes. These results show that high judge agreement can coexist with weak sensitivity to changes in the construct being evaluated, motivating joint reporting of invariance and sensitivity and auditing the validation set itself.
2608.24419.paper_summary_zh: LLM-as-a-judge 評估通常是通過一致性和對表面擾動的穩健性來評估，但可靠性並不能建立構念效度。我們將評估者的構念效度形式化為一個二維輪廓：不變性 S，即在保持構念的編輯下，裁決不變的概率，以及構念敏感性 R，即在最小改變構念的編輯下，裁決改變的概率。我們展示了 S 和 R 是獨立的，且沒有任何標量摘要能保留所有相關比較。我們在 7 位評審和 4 個領域中測量該輪廓，使用 7 種改變構念的干預類型和 5 種僅註冊的控制，干預方向由人工標註者確定，生成、驗證和評判分配給不同的模型系列。在匹配的不變性 S >= 0.90 時，評審的平均 S = 0.945，但 R = 0.319。敏感性在範圍和強度編輯之間也有所不同：R_scope = 0.383 與 R_strength = 0.262，所有 7 位評審的差距為 +0.121，符號一致。我們進一步審核了五個公共標籤集，發現僅表面預測器在配對模式下重現了 55%-67% 的標籤，包括 67.4% 的 MT-Bench 人類投票。這些結果顯示，高評審一致性可以與對所評估構念變化的低敏感性共存，促使不變性和敏感性的聯合報告以及對驗證集本身的審核。
